conventions: Use Gradle wrapper; on Windows use .\gradlew.bat.
Set JAVA_HOME to D:\Applications\Scoop\apps\intellij-jbr25-sdk-jcef\current for Gradle/DataDumper commands.
Reports should use explicit stable string IDs, not enum.name.

hard: Do not introduce equivalent dependency object/group:name/version reverse lookup shims.
Source namespace should come from mapping declaration/effective mapping namespace context or explicit DSL override.
User sourceNamespace must not be written to ModuleDependency.attributes.
If transform-chain source identity remains, rename REMAP_SOURCE_NAMESPACE_ATTRIBUTE symbol/helper to artifact-source-specific internal name.
New enum entries must use Kotlin/project style: Compile, Runtime, Run, Module, Project, File, IncludedBuild, NoArtifact, etc.
Reports must serialize stable explicit strings, not raw enum.name.
Final gate is DataDumper-only with --include-build D:/Projects/Minecraft/cloche.
soft: Keep modImplementation(notation, sourceNamespace=...) only where useful and aligned with declaration metadata.
Prefer keeping underlying internal Gradle attribute wire name stable if renaming code symbol is sufficient.
compatibility: Old RemapNamespaceAttribute helper may remain only as deprecated adapter if already implemented; it must not drive new DSL or leak to copied ModuleDependency.attributes.
Report external strings should be stable across enum renames.
security_requirements: Reports must avoid credentials, credentialed repository URLs, and environment secrets.
